Summary of what I built:
1. `cli.py` — standalone strict JSON entry with `{"error":"invalid"}` handling.
2. `scheduler.py` — the branchable engine: staged FIFO/PIFO banks, load-balanced dispatch with historical counters, fixed cyclic service opportunities, refill with pushout, live lag accounting + rank errors, sampling (explicit + automatic), conservative counter migration on repartition, cancel/inspect, save/restore branches with a reversible journal + slot-bound containers + materialization cache, and the final certificate.
3. `ordered.py` — repaired ordered storage (block-decomposed sorted multiset) replacing the buggy stub (which used bisect_left → unstable ordering and O(n) per insert).
4. `algorithms.py` — repaired rank policies with exact integer arithmetic (baseline WFQ used floats: `pkt.length / weight`) and certificates.
5. `adapter.py`, `utils.py`, `packet.py`, `sortedcontainers/__init__.py` — adapter glue and library compatibility.
6. `README.md` — design notes.

Key repairs of the baseline: PIFO stability (bisect_left insert bug), `SortedList.pop/remove` O(n), the enqueue condition (`<` vs `<=` fifo limit), the FIFO byte limit being derived instead of `fifo_bytes`, float WFQ ranks, refill not re-sorting/merging the candidate set, `_get_interval_index` mutating borders on out-of-range ranks, the `queue` global sorted-list maintenance bug (removed elements only removed when going through `_refill_from_fifo`), etc.

Time to finish.
